name: The Fang Bed
description: Bones of the wrong animal in the wrong rock.
arrival: A seam in the basalt full of bone, and the bone is all one kind of thing: heavy skulls with a pair of long teeth in the upper jaw and nothing like them since. They are lying in rock that formed after they should have been gone.
notes: The Fang, in the Scale's ground. `event_fang_vs_scale_wars` says the gorgonopsids held the fern forests and the archosaurs took the volcanic highlands -- so a bed of synapsid bone in basalt is the line being crossed, preserved. The player is not told that; the player is told the teeth do not match anything alive.
